short_description: Your GitHub contribution graph for the past year on the BUSY Bar's LED screen.
description:
## How to use

- Create a GitHub personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens.
- In the app's settings, enter your login and the token.

## What you see

The past year as columns of seven days, one column a week, in GitHub's shades of green. The app updates it every 30 minutes.

## Data

The GitHub GraphQL API with your token. The token stays in the app's settings on your BUSY Bar.
changelog: First release: a year of contributions, updated every 30 minutes.
